name: MongoDB Atlas
description: MongoDB Atlas Administration API for managing Atlas clusters, projects and organizations programmatically.
auth_notes: Service accounts (OAuth 2.0 client credentials) are recommended; programmatic API keys are a legacy method.
gate_detail: Atlas offers a free-forever M0 tier; credentials are created in an organization or project by users with suitable access roles. Whether the Admin API works on the free tier is not stated.
api_scope: Atlas Administration API for administrative tasks outside the Atlas UI, plus Go SDK, Atlas CLI, Terraform provider and other tooling.
mcp_notes: Sources mention MCP clients only as delegated access consumers; no vendor MCP server is described.
blocker_detail: Needs organization or project access to create service accounts or keys; optional IP access list restricts use.

evidence.quote: The Atlas Administration API uses one of two authentication methods to authenticate requests: service account or API keys.
We recommend you use service accounts instead of API keys to authenticate to the Atlas Administration API.
Yes, MongoDB Atlas offers a free-forever tier, the M0.
If you haven't already created a service account or API keys for an organization, you can create them for a project
You can interact with Atlas programmatically to perform administrative tasks or manage your deployments using the following resources.
